data.name: Versatile Performance (Keyboard Instruments)
data.description: You can use your bonus in the Perform (Keyboard Instruments) skill in place of your bonus in the Diplomacy or Intimidate skills. When substituting in this way, you use your total Perform (Keyboard Instruments) skill bonus, including class skill bonus, in place of your Diplomacy or Intimidate skill bonus, whether or not you have ranks in that skill or if it is a class skill.
